title: Random Alarm Sound
symptom: Users report random alarm sounds that cannot be identified or deactivated, with no further notification. The alarm occurs reproducibly on NS Client restart, connecting to Wi-Fi, and after un-pausing NS client.
cause: The thread suggests the alarm is related to Nightscout, possibly triggered by network changes, but the exact root cause is not definitively established. One user found that pausing Nightscout stops the sound, and another user points to xDrip+ profile import notification as a possible source.
fix: The thread suggests disabling NS alarms in preferences, but this did not work for one user. A user provided a link to xDrip documentation about AAPS Profile Import Notification, implying that disabling that notification in xDrip+ may resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: If you are using xDrip+ please check this: https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/AAPS_ProfileImportNotification.html
